---
title: "Nodata / Mask Reference"
subtitle: "Python & EO workflows"
format:
  typst:
    include-in-header: landscape.typ
---

+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| Protocol             | Nodata / mask standard         | Check for any nulls/masks (Python)                 |
+======================+================================+====================================================+
| `np.array`           | None built in: `np.nan`        | `np.isnan(arr).any()`\                             |
|                      | (float) or a sentinel          | `(arr == nodata).any()`                            |
|                      | (int)[^conv]                   |                                                    |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| `np.ma.masked_array` | Boolean mask, `True` =         | `m.mask.any()`                                     |
|                      | invalid[^sep]                  |                                                    |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| `pd.DataFrame`       | `NaN` / `None` / `pd.NA` /     | `df.isna().to_numpy().any()`                       |
|                      | `NaT`[^isna]                   |                                                    |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| SQLite               | SQL `NULL`[^null]              | `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE col IS        |
|                      |                                | NULL);`                                            |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| rasterio             | Mask 0 = invalid, 255 = valid; | `(src.read_masks(1) == 0).any()`\                  |
|                      | nodata optional[^allvalid]     | `src.read(1, masked=True).mask.any()`              |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| GDAL                 | Mask band 0 / 255 + separate   | `(band.GetMaskBand().ReadAsArray() == 0).any()`\   |
|                      | nodata value[^alpha]           | `(arr == nodata).any()`                            |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| GeoTIFF              | No standard; often             | `(src.read_masks(1) == 0).any()`\                  |
|                      | `TIFFTAG_GDAL_NODATA` + mask   | `(src.read(1) == src.nodata).any()`                |
|                      | band[^absent]                  |                                                    |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| Earth Engine         | Per-band mask: 0 = masked, >0  | `img.select('B2').mask()`\                         |
|                      | = valid[^ee]                   | `.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.min(), roi, scale)`\     |
|                      |                                | `.get('B2')`                                       |
+----------------------+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+

[^conv]: Must know the convention; no intrinsic nodata concept.
[^sep]: Mask stored separately from data.
[^isna]: `isna()` normalizes all NA types.
[^null]: Check per column; `NULL` ≠ empty string.
[^allvalid]: With no mask, may return an all-valid mask.
[^alpha]: Alpha masks may use the 0–255 range.
[^absent]: Nodata metadata may be absent.
[^ee]: e.g., `S2_SR_HARMONIZED`; must specify region + scale; masks are band-specific.
